meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂工作拆成多个环节,派给多个助手并行执行并汇总结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务太重,想拆给多个 AI 助手分头做完再统一汇总。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a task is too big to do alone and you want several assistants to split it and report back.

howto.what: 装上后,当你需要做多智能体协调时,Claude 会先确定本会话该用哪个 Orca 可执行文件,再运行 `ORCA skills get orchestration` 加载与版本匹配的指南,然后照指南执行命令。
howto.when: 当你需要结构化的多智能体协调时,例如任务 DAG、决策门、把工作拆给多个 agent 等;若只是把任务完整交给另一个 agent(handoff)或做普通终端操作,则改用 orca-cli。

say.text: 用 Orca 起一个协调循环,把任务派发给几个 worker
say.note: 会先加载版本匹配的指南再动手

say.text: 把这项工作拆成任务 DAG,并等 worker_done
say.note: Claude 会等待 worker 的完成结果

say.text: 这个决策门没过,帮我升级处理
say.note: Claude 按指南处理升级流程

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you need multi-agent coordination Claude first resolves which Orca executable to use for this session, runs `ORCA skills get orchestration` to load the version-matched guide, then acts on it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need structured multi-agent coordination, e.g. task DAGs, decision gates, or work split across agents. Plain handoffs to another agent and ordinary terminal work go to the orca-cli skill.

say_en.text: Start an Orca coordinator loop and dispatch tasks to a few workers
Split this work into a task DAG and wait for worker_done
say_en.note: Claude waits on the worker results

say_en.text: A decision gate failed - escalate it
